brief:
Israeli forces wounded a girl and an elderly woman with live ammunition shrapnel during a raid on Qusra, a village south of Nablus, Shehab Wire reported. The two Palestinians sustained injuries from shrapnel as Israeli troops conducted the operation in the West Bank community.

The incident marked another armed incursion into Palestinian territory in the Nablus area. No additional information was available regarding the specific circumstances that led to the shootings or the severity of the injuries sustained by the girl and the elderly woman.
